sign: A chapel the roots grew around. Services daily. The roots attend every one.
North: the Wandering Wood. East: Hymnmarsh. South: Gloamwater. West: the Chapel Rift.

lines: Sexton Aubrey: Sleep in the pews. If a root curls round your ankle, do not kick. It only wants to know you.
Gravedigger Thane: Nobody gets buried here any more. The roots come up and fetch them first.
Altar Girl Bess: Ossian says the moor must be fed. He never says who's on the menu, only that it's not him.
Father Lorne: I preached against the roots for thirty years. Now I water them. A man learns which side the pews are on.
